notes: Changes to this library or its order require management approval. AI may only select and rephrase approved questions.

questions.prompt: Roughly how many vehicles are in your fleet?
questions.help: A ballpark is perfect. Every fleet size is welcome.

questions.prompt: What kinds of vehicles do you run?
Which areas are you looking for help with?
questions.help: Pick any that fit. If it is not listed, tell us in the next question.

questions.prompt: What are you trying to accomplish?
questions.help: In your own words: the problem, the goal, or what prompted you to reach out.
questions.placeholder: e.g. We need forward and driver-facing cameras on 30 vans to reduce claims...

questions.prompt: Do you already have something in place today?
What do you use today, and what is or isn't working?
questions.placeholder: Brand, how long you've had it, what you'd change...

questions.help: We can coordinate installation through qualified providers where needed.

questions.prompt: When are you hoping to move forward?
Where are your vehicles based or operating?

questions.placeholder: Must integrate with our dispatch software; nice to have driver coaching...

questions.prompt: Any constraints we should know about?
questions.placeholder: Budget range, union rules, downtime windows, approved vendor lists...

questions.prompt: Do you have a budget range in mind?
